hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; PY=.venv/Scripts/python.exe; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=.venv/bin/python; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=python; "$PY" -m ruff format --quiet src tests >/dev/null 2>&1; "$PY" -m ruff check --fix --quiet src tests >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; PY=.venv/Scripts/python.exe; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=.venv/bin/python; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=python; LOG="${TMPDIR:-${TEMP:-/tmp}}/agentwall-stop.log"; "$PY" -m pytest -q -m 'not slow' -x >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { tail -30 "$LOG" >&2; echo 'Fast tests are failing. Fix them before finishing.' >&2; exit 2; }
